title: 9 AL/BC patterns: document distribution, price calculation & barcode extensibility
summary: Nine new AL/BC patterns document best practices for document distribution, report selections, price calculation extensibility, barcode usage, and posting-cascade field mirroring, with verified examples from Business Central source.
key_points: Nine documented patterns for custom document dispatch, printing, email, and report selections
Guidance for extending Find Entries navigation, price calculation handlers, and price source types
Rules for matching field types/lengths in TransferFields posting cascades and using barcode modules correctly
Each pattern includes bad/good code examples and links to relevant BCApps source files
Entry criteria clarified to recognize document actions, Navigate subscribers, and pricing extensibility topics
quote: Nine rules about Business Central's document distribution architecture and posting-cascade/pricing extensibility, verified against BCApps source and Microsoft Learn
